taskPrompt: a coffee mug with a handle

messages.content:
You are an illustrator who writes SVG by hand.

Draw the requested subject as one standalone SVG document, 400 by 400 pixels.
Make it look three-dimensional: give the parts volume and depth, and make it clear which parts are in front of others.
Use only what SVG itself provides. Do not use scripts, external images, external fonts or links.
Reply with the SVG document only: no explanation and no Markdown code fence.
Draw this: a coffee mug with a handle.

response.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 400" width="400" height="400">
  <defs>
    <!-- Background Gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="bgGrad" cx="50%" cy="45%" r="65%" fx="50%" fy="45%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f5f3ef" />
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#e3dfd9" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c4bdb2" />
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Drop Shadow Gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="dropShadow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1c1512" stop-opacity="0.7" />
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#332822" stop-opacity="0.4" />
      <stop offset="75%" stop-color="#4d3d35" stop-opacity="0.1" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4d3d35" stop-opacity="0" />
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Handle Shadow Gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="handleShadow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#332822" stop-opacity="0.25" />
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#4d3d35" stop-opacity="0.08" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4d3d35" stop-opacity="0" />
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Mug Body Main 3D Cylinder Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="mugBody" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#5cdbd6" />    <!-- Back rim light -->
      <stop offset="6%" stop-color="#2ea8a9" />    <!-- Left edge curve -->
      <stop offset="22%" stop-color="#6ce3df" />   <!-- Main highlight zone -->
      <stop offset="42%" stop-color="#229193" />   <!-- Midtone -->
      <stop offset="74%" stop-color="#0b555a" />   <!-- Core shadow -->
      <stop offset="91%" stop-color="#0f6c72" />   <!-- Ambient bounce -->
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#063438" />  <!-- Right edge shadow -->
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Mug Bottom Vertical Shading (ambient occlusion & grounding) -->
    <linearGradient id="mugBottomFade" x1="0%" y1="55%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#052426" stop-opacity="0" />
      <stop offset="75%" stop-color="#052426" stop-opacity="0.25" />
      <stop offset="93%" stop-color="#03191b" stop-opacity="0.6" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f5f3ef" stop-opacity="0.25" /> <!-- Table bounce light -->
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Ceramic Foot (un-glazed bottom ring) -->
    <linearGradient id="ceramicFoot" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#b8b0a4" />
      <stop offset="25%" stop-color="#e3dcd2" />
      <stop offset="65%" stop-color="#9e9589" />
      <stop offset="90%" stop-color="#6e665c" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4a443d" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Mug Interior Depth Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="mugInside" x1="0%" y1="15%" x2="100%" y2="35%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#042224" />
      <stop offset="20%" stop-color="#0a4549" />
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#1d8587" />
      <stop offset="88%" stop-color="#53cfcc" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2fa2a3" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Top Rim Bevel Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="rimTop" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="10%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#87f5f1" />
      <stop offset="25%" stop-color="#cbfaf8" />
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#35aca8" />
      <stop offset="85%" stop-color="#12686c" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#42bab7" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Coffee Liquid Gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="coffeeLiquid" cx="62%" cy="55%" r="55%" fx="65%" fy="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#52250c" />
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#2e1204" />
      <stop offset="80%" stop-color="#170801" />
      <stop offset="96%" stop-color="#0a0300" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#240e03" />
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Crema / Foam Ring Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="cremaGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="20%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9c6234" />
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#c98d59" />
      <stop offset="80%" stop-color="#7d4a22" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b57a48" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Handle Base Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="handleBase" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="10%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#0b4f54" />
      <stop offset="30%" stop-color="#1d8587" />
      <stop offset="65%" stop-color="#3dc2bf" />
      <stop offset="85%" stop-color="#146c70" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#052a2d" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Handle Inner/Underneath Shadow -->
    <linearGradient id="handleUnder" x1="20%" y1="0%" x2="80%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#042224" />
      <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#073b3e" />
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#1b7d80" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#05292b" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Handle Top/Outer Highlight -->
    <linearGradient id="handleHighlight" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#b8fcf9" />
      <stop offset="25%" stop-color="#5cdbd6" />
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#197b7e" stop-opacity="0" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Specular Reflection Filter (Soft Glow) -->
    <filter id="softBlur" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3.5" />
    </filter>
    
    <filter id="tightBlur" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="120%" height="120%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="1.2" />
    </filter>

    <filter id="steamBlur" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="7" />
    </filter>

    <!-- Steam Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="steamGrad" x1="0%" y1="100%" x2="0%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0" />
      <stop offset="25%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.35" />
      <stop offset="65%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.18" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Clip Path for Mug Body -->
    <clipPath id="bodyClip">
      <path d="M 75,115 C 75,190 79,255 86,298 C 89,316 125,330 175,330 C 225,330 261,316 264,298 C 271,255 275,190 275,115 Z" />
    </clipPath>

    <!-- Clip Path for Mug Interior (Rim Area) -->
    <clipPath id="insideClip">
      <ellipse cx="175" cy="115" rx="91" ry="27.5" />
    </clipPath>
  </defs>

  <!-- 1. Background & Surface -->
  <rect width="400" height="400" fill="url(#bgGrad)" />
  <!-- Subtle horizon/table line fade -->
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="340" rx="250" ry="90" fill="#d5cfc6" opacity="0.4" filter="url(#steamBlur)" />

  <!-- 2. Cast Shadows on Table -->
  <!-- Handle cast shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="305" cy="322" rx="65" ry="18" transform="rotate(-6 305 322)" fill="url(#handleShadow)" />
  <!-- Main mug cast shadow (offset slightly right/back) -->
  <ellipse cx="188" cy="322" rx="118" ry="34" fill="url(#dropShadow)" />
  <!-- Tight dark contact shadow directly under the base -->
  <ellipse cx="175" cy="319" rx="84" ry="20" fill="#17110e" opacity="0.75" filter="url(#tightBlur)" />

  <!-- 3. Ceramic Foot (Bottom Ring) -->
  <path d="M 94,300 C 96,317 130,331 175,331 C 220,331 254,317 256,300 C 256,305 220,326 175,326 C 130,326 94,305 94,300 Z" fill="url(#ceramicFoot)" />

  <!-- 4. Mug Main Body -->
  <g clip-path="url(#bodyClip)">
    <!-- Base cylinder shading -->
    <rect x="70" y="110" width="210" height="225" fill="url(#mugBody)" />
    
    <!-- Shadow cast by the handle onto the right side of the mug body -->
    <path d="M 255,145 C 240,165 242,265 252,285 C 262,300 275,285 275,285 L 275,145 Z" fill="#031c1e" opacity="0.55" filter="url(#softBlur)" />

    <!-- Bottom ambient occlusion & table bounce light -->
    <rect x="70" y="110" width="210" height="225" fill="url(#mugBottomFade)" />

    <!-- Primary Vertical Specular Highlight (Window Reflection) -->
    <path d="M 103,125 C 103,195 106,255 112,308 C 117,311 125,314 131,315 C 125,255 123,195 123,125 Z" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.48" filter="url(#softBlur)" />
    <!-- Sharp core of the highlight -->
    <path d="M 108,130 C 108,195 111,255 116,305 C 119,306 122,307 124,308 C 119,255 117,195 117,130 Z" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5" filter="url(#tightBlur)" />

    <!-- Secondary Soft Highlight -->
    <path d="M 86,125 C 86,195 89,255 95,300 C 97,302 99,303 101,304 C 95,255 93,195 93,125 Z" fill="#b8fcf9" opacity="0.35" filter="url(#tightBlur)" />

    <!-- Subtle Rim Bounce Light on Far Right Edge -->
    <path d="M 267,130 C 267,190 264,250 258,295 C 261,293 263,290 264,286 C 270,245 272,190 272,130 Z" fill="#5cdbd6" opacity="0.25" filter="url(#tightBlur)" />
  </g>

  <!-- 5. Mug Handle (Layered for 3D Depth) -->
  <g>
    <!-- Handle attachment shadow on body (top & bottom) -->
    <ellipse cx="268" cy="158" rx="8" ry="18" transform="rotate(-10 268 158)" fill="#031f21" opacity="0.7" filter="url(#tightBlur)" />
    <ellipse cx="258" cy="268" rx="8" ry="16" transform="rotate(15 258 268)" fill="#031f21" opacity="0.8" filter="url(#tightBlur)" />

    <!-- Base Handle Shape -->
    <path d="M 266,142 
             C 325,130 368,165 362,218 
             C 356,268 308,292 256,278 
             C 252,272 253,254 259,250 
             C 295,260 328,246 332,214 
             C 336,178 306,162 265,172 
             C 261,166 262,148 266,142 Z" 
          fill="url(#handleBase)" />

    <!-- Handle Inner/Underneath Depth (Darker core & underside) -->
    <path d="M 265,172 
             C 306,162 336,178 332,214 
             C 328,246 295,260 259,250 
             C 256,256 255,264 256,270
             C 300,280 342,258 347,215
             C 352,170 315,148 264,162 Z" 
          fill="url(#handleUnder)" />

    <!-- Handle Outer/Top Surface Highlight -->
    <path d="M 266,142 
             C 325,130 368,165 362,218 
             C 357,260 318,284 270,278
             C 312,278 347,255 351,216
             C 356,170 318,142 265,152 Z" 
          fill="url(#handleHighlight)" />

    <!-- Specular Gloss Strip on Top Curve of Handle -->
    <path d="M 272,147 C 315,139 348,160 353,195 C 346,165 314,147 272,153 Z" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.75" filter="url(#tightBlur)" />
    
    <!-- Secondary Gloss on Lower Outer Handle Curve -->
    <path d="M 356,215 C 352,248 325,270 285,273 C 320,267 346,245 351,215 Z" fill="#87f5f1" opacity="0.4" filter="url(#tightBlur)" />

    <!-- Smooth Seam Blend at Top Attachment -->
    <path d="M 262,139 C 270,143 273,144 276,143 C 272,155 271,165 274,173 C 268,171 264,172 260,176 C 264,164 265,150 262,139 Z" fill="url(#handleBase)" opacity="0.9" filter="url(#tightBlur)" />
    <!-- Seam Crease Highlight -->
    <path d="M 265,142 C 268,150 268,162 264,172" stroke="#5cdbd6" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.5" filter="url(#tightBlur)" />
    <path d="M 258,250 C 261,258 260,268 255,277" stroke="#1d8587" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.6" filter="url(#tightBlur)" />
  </g>

  <!-- 6. Mug Rim & Interior -->
  <!-- Outer Rim Bevel -->
  <ellipse cx="175" cy="115" rx="100" ry="31" fill="url(#rimTop)" />

  <!-- Interior Hollow & Coffee (Clipped to inner rim) -->
  <g clip-path="url(#insideClip)">
    <!-- Inner ceramic wall -->
    <ellipse cx="175" cy="115" rx="93" ry="29" fill="url(#mugInside)" />
    
    <!-- Inner wall top shadow (just under the left/front lip) -->
    <path d="M 80,115 C 80,98 122,85 175,85 C 228,85 270,98 270,115 C 270,103 228,91 175,91 C 122,91 80,103 80,115 Z" fill="#021314" opacity="0.5" filter="url(#tightBlur)" />

    <!-- Inner wall highlight (right side catching light) -->
    <ellipse cx="245" cy="118" rx="30" ry="18" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.3" filter="url(#softBlur)" />

    <!-- Coffee Crema / Meniscus Edge -->
    <ellipse cx="175" cy="128" rx="88" ry="27" fill="url(#cremaGrad)" />
    
    <!-- Main Dark Coffee Pool -->
    <ellipse cx="175" cy="129.5" rx="84.5" ry="25.5" fill="url(#coffeeLiquid)" />

    <!-- Coffee Surface Depth Shadow (Left side shadow from mug wall) -->
    <path d="M 88,128 C 88,112 128,102 180,102 C 150,106 115,115 110,132 C 105,145 130,152 150,154 C 110,151 88,140 88,128 Z" fill="#050200" opacity="0.6" filter="url(#tightBlur)" />

    <!-- Tiny Foam Bubbles along the Crema Edge (Left & Right) -->
    <g fill="#dfa673" opacity="0.7">
      <circle cx="95" cy="124" r="1.8" />
      <circle cx="98" cy="121" r="1.2" />
      <circle cx="94" cy="128" r="1.4" />
      <circle cx="101" cy="119" r="0.9" />
      <circle cx="105" cy="116" r="1.5" />
      <circle cx="109" cy="115" r="0.8" />
      
      <circle cx="252" cy="123" r="2.1" />
      <circle cx="255" cy="127" r="1.5" />
      <circle cx="249" cy="120" r="1.3" />
      <circle cx="254" cy="130" r="1.1" />
      <circle cx="245" cy="118" r="0.9" />
      <circle cx="248" cy="133" r="1.4" />
      <circle cx="238" cy="138" r="1.2" />
    </g>
    <!-- Bubble Highlights -->
    <g fill="#ffe4c4" opacity="0.8">
      <circle cx="94.5" cy="123.5" r="0.7" />
      <circle cx="104.5" cy="115.5" r="0.6" />
      <circle cx="251.5" cy="122.5" r="0.8" />
      <circle cx="254.5" cy="126.5" r="0.6" />
      <circle cx="247.5" cy="132.5" r="0.5" />
    </g>

    <!-- Glossy Liquid Surface Reflections -->
    <!-- Main curved window reflection on coffee -->
    <path d="M 112,126 C 122,115 152,110 185,111 C 178,115 168,116 152,117 C 132,118 120,123 112,126 Z" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.45" filter="url(#tightBlur)" />
    <!-- Sharp bright reflection core -->
    <path d="M 120,122 C 132,115 155,112 175,113 C 168,115 155,115 142,117 C 130,118 124,120 120,122 Z" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.65" />
    
    <!-- Secondary front meniscus reflection (liquid curving up the front wall) -->
    <path d="M 130,151 C 155,155 195,155 220,150 C 195,153 155,153 130,151 Z" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5" filter="url(#tightBlur)" />
  </g>

  <!-- 7. Rim Specular Highlights (Popping the 3D top edge) -->
  <!-- Front-left strong rim highlight -->
  <path d="M 78,118 C 84,134 126,145 178,145 C 128,143 89,132 82,117 Z" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.85" filter="url(#tightBlur)" />
  <path d="M 88,125 C 102,137 138,144 172,144 C 138,143 105,135 90,124 Z" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9" />

  <!-- Back-right rim highlight -->
  <path d="M 185,84.5 C 232,85.5 268,97 274,112 C 266,99 230,88 185,86 Z" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.65" filter="url(#tightBlur)" />
  
  <!-- Inner edge subtle catchlight (back-left) -->
  <path d="M 84,113 C 88,99 125,88 170,87.5 C 127,89 92,100 86,114 Z" fill="#87f5f1" opacity="0.45" />

  <!-- 8. Rising Steam Wisps -->
  <g filter="url(#steamBlur)" mix-blend-mode="screen">
    <!-- Center main wisp -->
    <path d="M 165,120 C 145,90 195,65 175,30 C 165,12 180,5 185,0 C 195,15 180,25 190,45 C 205,75 160,95 178,120 Z" fill="url(#steamGrad)" />
    <!-- Left wisp -->
    <path d="M 130,115 C 115,92 135,70 122,45 C 114,30 120,15 130,8 C 125,22 125,32 134,48 C 148,72 125,92 140,115 Z" fill="url(#steamGrad)" opacity="0.75" />
    <!-- Right wisp -->
    <path d="M 210,112 C 228,88 202,62 218,38 C 226,25 220,12 212,5 C 216,18 216,28 206,42 C 190,65 215,88 198,114 Z" fill="url(#steamGrad)" opacity="0.65" />
  </g>
</svg>
